criteria: London · Cybersecurity / Observability / Cloud Infra / Devtools · Series C–pre-IPO · OTE £200k+ · Last 30 days
searchNote: JobDataLake API unavailable this run; roles sourced from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, LinkedIn, and company careers pages. Expired listings excluded.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director – UK
jobs.fitNote: Cato invented the SASE category — Jack's deepest technical domain — and is ripping legacy MPLS and firewall stacks out of enterprises, precisely the displacement motion Jack has built his career on. At $415M ARR and 43% growth, Cato has a credible IPO trajectory, and a UK Regional Director sits at C-level (CISO/CTO/CIO) across financial services and large enterprise accounts. Territory ownership model aligns directly with Jack's MEDDPICC rigour and forecast discipline.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President, Sales – EMEA
jobs.funding: Sequoia, Lightspeed, Redpoint, Menlo backed · Series C · pre-IPO
jobs.fitNote: Semgrep is the RVP seat Jack is built for: full EMEA P&L ownership, a 2-to-10 team build from scratch, and a Gartner-recognised AppSec platform where the buyer is the CISO and security engineering lead. The OTE is explicitly confirmed at £300k. Jack's displacement narrative — making a category shift rather than selling upgrades — maps directly to Semgrep's case against legacy SAST tools. Backed by Sequoia and actively building toward IPO. The 37% quota attainment rate reflects a nascent EMEA motion that's the exact 0-to-1 challenge Jack has solved before.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager, EMEA
jobs.funding: Series D · $100M ARR target · 300% revenue growth
jobs.fitNote: Torq's AI-native SOC automation platform is displacing legacy SIEM and SOAR stacks — Jack's core motion. The company has 300% revenue growth, Series D backing, and just opened its EMEA HQ in London. MEDDPICC and enterprise C-level selling are explicit requirements, matching Jack's toolkit exactly. The title ('Manager' not 'Director') is below Jack's target, and the 15–19% AE quota attainment rate from RepVue is a yellow flag worth probing in the process. OTE undisclosed — worth clarifying before committing time.
jobs.flag: Title is RSM not RSD. Probe OTE and quota attainment data in first call.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales – UKI & Nordics
jobs.fitNote: Observability is Jack's top priority sector and the Director, UKI & Nordics seat is a genuine step-up title. However, New Relic was taken private by Francisco Partners in 2023 with no IPO narrative, has 5,500+ employees making this a large mature vendor move, and the role skews toward expansion/retention of an existing book rather than the displacement hunting Jack specialises in. Include as a stretch option if the pipeline is thin, but deprioritise against true growth-stage roles.
jobs.flag: PE-backed, 5,500+ employees — large mature vendor. Expansion-focused not pure new business.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Regional Sales
jobs.fitNote: Infoblox's DNS Security Intelligence and BloxOne SASE products sit within Jack's network security domain and the Senior Director title is an upgrade from his current role. However, Vista Equity acquired Infoblox in 2022 making this a PE-backed company at ~2,500 employees with no IPO narrative — the opposite of the growth-stage story Jack is looking for. RepVue at 77 and mixed reviews about sales org politics are further caution signals. Worth a conversation but not a priority pursuit.
jobs.flag: PE-backed, ~2,500 employees — classic mature company profile. No IPO pathway visible.
